stream.camera_role: second wrist camera rigidly mounted on opposite side of handheld gripper

why_absent: The corrected CAD recipe selected only right_main_camera_rgb because attached camera intrinsics and attached optical pose are absent. Source and backup retain both videos.
image_observation: Both jaw backsides and blue connectors are visible, and the workpiece appears rotated relative to the main camera because the D405 is physically on the opposite side. This is not a file-rotation error.
state_definition: Zarr state already is TCP. Marker-to-TCP [0,-0.13423,0.135]m/identity applies to CAD alignment only. No state or training data was modified.

attached_metadata_keys.right_attached_camera_0_video_pipeline: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 -s 640x480 -r {fps} -i - -vf format=yuv420p -c:v av1_nvenc -gpu {gpu} -preset p4 -cq 36 -g 16 -an {output}
attached_metadata_keys.right_attached_camera_0_note: Second hand-eye camera ('additional_camera', 640x480 / 30 fps, a RealSense by the capture script; the paper names D455 and D405, and the 1280x800 stream is the D455). It looks at the jaws from the opposite side of the device, so its image is upside down relative to the main camera; frames are stored as released. No intrinsics and no pose relative to the main camera are published, so no right_attached_camera_0_pose_in_main_xyz_wxyz is written.

marker_check.result: No jaw markers detected on backside; the main-view marker faces point away from this camera.

rigidity_check.method: LK direct frame0 to every source frame on nine manually selected connector backside corners
rigidity_check.limitation: Direct LK status alone does not reject occlusion/edge confusion; the large p90 drift makes these tracks unsuitable for calibration. The device mount is rigid by the supplied assembly, not inferred from these tracks.

diagnostic_pose_fit.geometry: All selected connector corners lie on TCP y=-0.012698m plane
diagnostic_pose_fit.intrinsic_assumptions: fx=fy swept; principal point fixed at image centre; distortion zero
limitations: Single view of planar backside corners cannot independently identify a general camera intrinsic matrix and pose.
Hand-selected corners have annotation/correspondence uncertainty; residuals are diagnostic fit error, not heldout validation.
Physical housing constrains possible camera origins and rotations but lacks the optical centre.
The blue pusher tool held between jaws is absent from the supplied CAD.
Visible black finger edges offer some nonplanar geometry but are partly occluded by the held blue pusher; no independent heldout fingertip validation was established.

next_step: Make D405 native raw playback available now and label that no calibrated projection is available.
Obtain D405 640x480 intrinsics/distortion; an optical frame relative to TCP or D455 would also directly constrain the missing mount.
With measured intrinsics, fit/verify camera pose against CAD corners plus independent visible fingertip/edge landmarks across multiple episodes and jaw widths.
Recompute camera optical trajectory from world_T_tcp @ tcp_T_D405 only in a new versioned export after validation.
